# SDK-01 v0.4 proposed implementation context

Baseline `ff34c2c4fe58be0c1e7bf75f954b0972a760db02`. This package is a draft and does not authorize P32. Existing Windows and Web Debug UI use `MultiSelectionPort` directly. The current owner submits one whole semantic value for all eligible roots; it has no public per-root read or leaf-preserving patch. A replacement control is not evidence of a leaf-patch product failure.

The proposed ABI and C consumer scenarios are pinned by SHA-256 in `authority.lock.json`. They compile only and are not linked or run. Maintain one SelectionSession, canonical document, History and Scene. Proposed order: implement validated SDK core and per-root path; run real external consumer and owner checks; migrate both actual hosts; verify Windows and Chrome drivers; seal internal port only after parity.

The P20 oracle and platform drivers are not materialized or accepted; API01-API12 continue to apply. D07 OOM, MSE-20/23/26 and physical testing remain open. The old v0.2 package and its results remain immutable.

The phase-order amendment freezes real independent test intent before P32 and requires actual SDK/Windows/Chrome drivers and results at P32 exit. It does not require nonexistent product tests to already pass before implementation; all other P20/API completeness and acceptance blockers remain. The actual lifecycle link baseline is recorded at revision a92c05734cd81f0f11e285692015d324239fbd7f.
